notes: Three variant units resolve to the base and none changes the English.

ἔκραζεν → he cried out: the unit and the head on cried are right, but κράζω is not a compound verb and out is an obligatory English idiom particle riding with it under rule 7, not a preverb realization under rule 106.
κρίνομαι → am called in question heads on the meaning-bearing complement (rule 17); heading on called remains defensible.
